1. Take the c-th and the (100 - c)-th centile of each disk of diameter l.
2. Filter each again with the other centile, to get the centile opening and closing.
3. Smooth the difference between the input and each with a Gaussian of sigma 0.33 l.
4. Mix the opening and closing, each weighted by the other's smoothed error.
